bill.title: Virtual Currency Kiosk Consumer Protection Act.

posted_text:
💰 NC HB 920 — North Carolina Just Made It Easier to Use Crypto

North Carolina is paving the way for digital assets by creating a high bar for new cryptocurrencies – they need a $750 billion market cap, 10 years of stable operation, and a proven security track record to be considered a valid form of payment. This means your local crypto kiosk has a lot of meeting to get to!
